title: The phase diagram of injective-to-projective tensor distortion
summary: For finite-dimensional Banach spaces $E$ and $F$, set \[ ρ(E,F):=\sup_{0\neq z\in E\otimes F}\frac{π(z)}{\varepsilon(z)}. \] The square growth of $ρ(\ell_p^d,\ell_q^d)$ was determined by Bonet, Defant, Peris and Ramanujan. We study the rectangular problem with the two dimensions varying independently. If $r=\min\{n,m\}$ and $η(t)=\min\{1/t,1/t'\}$, then, whenever $p$ and $q$ lie on the same side of $2$, \[ ρ(\ell_p^n,\ell_q^m)\asymp_{p,q} r^{1/2}\min\{n^{η(p)},m^{η(q)}\}. \] Thus the classical square exponent splits into two dimensional scales. In the mixed range $1\le p\le2\le q\le\infty$,…
